title: r9 analysis: why locked r8 diverges, especially the stove
scope: analysis only; no k/angle/post retune; no F3/F5; no commit; blender_inner.py / run_blender_final.py / ue_filmic.py not modified

diagnostic.kind: Blender dump + Workbench clay (geometry only). Did not change blender_inner.py. Default Standard identity not touched.

hypotheses.H1: REJECTED — gold is 前视图 3c8d747b (task's only view; backup views_in_task agrees). 透视 and other cameras exist in the official 5-cam template but were not used for this gold.
hypotheses.H2: REJECTED as the primary 'wrong camera convention' cause. Applied look-down is 30.0° at blender loc [0, 0.9, -1.45]; clay/r8 silhouette width matches gold (72–1846). Residual: gold is 59 px taller at the back; left burner grate missing in our scene (is_visible=false on several zuobianzaomian*).
hypotheses.H3: REJECTED at 16:9. fov 35 horizontal, sensor 24.576, sensor_fit HORIZONTAL. Width boxes match. UE SetFieldOfView(fov)+MaintainYFOV does not change a 16:9 frame authored at 16:9.
hypotheses.H4: REJECTED. Official UE 5.5.4 glTFs with rot [-90,-90,180] scale 0.1 still sit horizontal after mesh_basis_from_ue (zaojumian thin in Y, 0.86×0.0012×0.45 m). That actor xform is the cm-scale official-template convention, not a mis-rotation of the hob.
hypotheses.H6: REJECTED — render_task backup 20261024 scene_json cameras/models/lights identical to r8 raw; output 7680×4320, 2048 spp.
hypotheses.B1: SUPPORTED — k=3.1 is empirical on 329c and should not be a universal scale.
hypotheses.B2: UNRESOLVED — ue55 post still doc-sourced; same formula on all 5, cannot alone explain stove dark vs others bright.
hypotheses.B3: PARTIALLY — Candelas is engine-source confirmed (SpawnLight). Cycles W=pi*I/683 (area) / 4pi*I/683 (point) is still reasoned, not Path Tracer verified. Stove mapped total is 0.532 W; RectLight24 is 0.1784 W on a 10×10 m panel.
hypotheses.B4: SUPPORTED — identity light groups still inject swap_yz@ue_basis. Stove depth-2 mirrors lights (RectLight24 6.593389 m off, z +3.213 vs -3.213). Darkness and (apparent) 'edge-on black glass' share this lighting root, plus B6, not a separate camera bug.
hypotheses.B5: REJECTED as 'lights dropped' — all 13 imported and visible; they are misplaced (B4), not missing.
hypotheses.B6: SUPPORTED as a major stove gap — white-sky-scale 0 + skylight 0 removes all env light. UE white path keeps a visible White.White skybox at HDRI_Brightness=100; Path Tracer may light from that skybox. Not re-rendered this pass.
hypotheses.C: CONFIRMED — hood decal 卡萨帝logo (f623dfcf, M_New_Decal_Master) exists in scene JSON; blender_inner.py has no decal path.
